create_lda_model: create a LatentDirichletAllocation model with 10 topics and online learning method
fit_lda_on_document_matrix: fit a LatentDirichletAllocation model on a document word count matrix
transform_documents_to_topics: transform a document word matrix into topic distributions using a fitted LDA model
calculate_lda_perplexity: calculate perplexity of a fitted LatentDirichletAllocation model on a document matrix
score_lda_log_likelihood: score a fitted LatentDirichletAllocation model using approximate log-likelihood
